prompts.desktop-overview:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: first design concept for the Requant Wallet desktop application on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Primary request: Generate a polished high-fidelity product UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, large readable text. One flat desktop app window shown straight on, with generous margins, on an ivory studio backdrop. No perspective, no laptop or phone hardware. This is a design concept, not a working wallet.
Input image 1: reference only for the approved Requant visual identity, angular orange R mark, ivory/graphite/orange colors, bold typography. Preserve this brand, design an original wallet layout.
Visual direction: precise, calm, premium crypto-native utility. Warm ivory #f2efe8 canvas, white #fbfaf7 panels, graphite #171717 text, vivid orange #ff5426 primary actions. Fine graphite rules, small 12px corner radii, generous whitespace. Large bold sans headings, clean Inter-like body, mono numerals and abbreviated addresses. Sharp flat UI, subtle shadows only. A very faint 8-layer grid motif as a tiny decorative accent in the balance panel, never behind text. No neon, no blue or purple, no glassmorphism, no ornamental coin renders.
Composition: 208px pale left sidebar with the exact angular orange Requant R and title "Requant Wallet". Navigation "Overview" selected with orange marker, then "Activity", "Receive", "Settings". At bottom show "Lock wallet" and "v0.1 / Concept". Main workspace with page title "Overview", "Main wallet" selector, "TESTNET" badge, and separate small "Node connected" status.
Main hero: small label "Confirmed balance", very large "1,248.50000000", understated "RQT". Two clear actions "Send" orange and "Receive" outlined. Below a thin row "Pending 12.00000000 RQT" and "Maturing 36.00000000 RQT". This is a single native asset; do not show token collections or dollar conversions.
Below: broad "Recent activity" table with simple received/sent arrow icons, type, abbreviated address, status, amount and time. Three tidy rows: "Received" "Confirmed" "+48.00000000 RQT" "12 min ago"; "Sent" "Confirmed" "-12.50000000 RQT" "1 hour ago"; "Mining reward" "Maturing" "+3.76000000 RQT" "2 hours ago". Right-side smaller receive card: title "Your address", illustrative QR placeholder, visible shortened address "trq1q...7d9p", button "Copy address", link "Open in explorer". The QR is a visual placeholder, not intended for scanning.
Bottom line inside app "Testnet coins have no value." Board caption outside app "DESKTOP / OVERVIEW" and "Design concept · Illustrative data". All displayed content in English.
Constraints: Keep text legible and spelled correctly. Exactly one app window. Keep visible testnet badge. Do not suggest this is a released or audited product. No charts of price, fiat values, buy/swap/stake/earn, DeFi, NFTs, seed phrase, real private keys, admin/server password controls, iOS, Russian text, geopolitical imagery or MagnetGate branding.
prompts.android-core-flows:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Requant Wallet Android app design board, three complete screen mockups.
Primary request: High-fidelity flat UI presentation, landscape 16:10, three equally sized tall Android screen rectangles in one aligned horizontal row, fully visible with generous gutters, no perspective and no physical device render. Screens roughly 412 by 892 logical pixels, large readable typography, practical tap targets. Same visual language as the reference Requant site, adapted to a native wallet app.
Input image 1: visual identity reference only. Preserve the angular orange Requant R, warm ivory #f2efe8, white #fbfaf7 panels, graphite #171717, orange #ff5426. Bold Inter-like typography, mono numbers and addresses, fine rules, 12px card corners, restrained shadows. No neon, no glassmorphism. Android-style simple status bars, no iPhone notch or iOS home indicator.
Screen one "Overview": small Requant Wallet brand at top and visible "TESTNET" chip, wallet selector "Main wallet". Label "Confirmed balance", large "1,248.50000000" and "RQT". Side-by-side actions "Send" orange and "Receive" outlined. Compact "Pending 12.00000000 RQT" and "Maturing 36.00000000 RQT". "Recent activity" with two rows "Received" "+48.00000000 RQT" "Confirmed" and "Sent" "-12.50000000 RQT" "Confirmed". Bottom navigation "Home", "Activity", "Settings" with thin line icons. Footer "Testnet coins have no value."
Screen two "Send RQT": back arrow, title, TESTNET badge. Recipient field label "Recipient address", placeholder "trq1q..." with scan icon. Amount field showing "12.50000000" and "RQT", small "Max" action. Caption "Available 1,248.50000000 RQT". Summary shows "Network fee 0.00001000 RQT" and "Total 12.50001000 RQT". Large orange button "Review transfer". No broadcast immediately from amount entry; a review step precedes final confirmation. English footnote "Testnet only".
Screen three "Receive RQT": back arrow, title, TESTNET badge. Large centered illustrative QR placeholder in a white card, below it label "Your testnet address" and shortened monospaced address "trq1q...7d9p". Primary button "Copy address", secondary "Share address". Small helpful line "Only receive RQT on Requant testnet." A quiet "Open in explorer" link. No deposit to an exchange account.
Outside the screens, minimal board title "REQUANT WALLET / ANDROID", under each screen its name. Small outside caption "Design concept · Illustrative data · QR placeholder". All English. Maintain identical spacing, icons and colors across screens.
Avoid: iOS devices/chrome, dollar prices, token portfolios, buy/swap/stake/earn, invented security audits, real private keys, seed phrases, admin/server credentials, Russian text, geography or MagnetGate identity.
Input image 2: reference for the matching Requant Wallet desktop component styling and typography. Match its visual identity, adapt navigation and controls to Android.
prompts.wallet-setup-and-review:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Requant Wallet desktop setup and transaction-review design board.
Primary request: High-fidelity flat UI design presentation, landscape 16:10, four coherent small app panels in a clean 2 by 2 grid. Large legible typography with generous margins. The identity comes from the reference Requant design, but the layouts are for an encrypted local wallet. Warm ivory #f2efe8, white #fbfaf7, graphite #171717, orange #ff5426. Preserve angular orange Requant R. Fine rules, 12px corner radii, strong modern sans headings, mono amounts, no neon or glassmorphism. All panels are desktop app screens without OS-specific chrome, usable for Windows, macOS and Linux.
Input image 1: brand and visual-style reference only.
Panel one: wallet welcome screen with Requant Wallet mark, TESTNET badge, title "Set up your wallet", subtitle "Create a wallet or restore an encrypted backup." Large orange "Create wallet" action and outlined "Restore wallet" action. Small label "Local key storage". Quiet footer "Testnet coins have no value."
Panel two: creation screen "Protect your wallet" with step label "CREATE / 01". Fields "Wallet name" with "Main wallet", "Wallet password" masked dots, "Confirm password" masked dots. Helpful short text "This password unlocks your wallet on this device." Orange button "Create encrypted wallet". Do not show a seed phrase or OAuth/social account.
Panel three: backup screen "Save your wallet backup" with step label "BACKUP / 02". Simple outlined file icon and filename "requant-wallet.key". Text "Keep the encrypted file and its password. Both are needed to restore your wallet." Orange "Save backup file" button, checkbox "I saved my backup" and subdued "Continue" button. This is a deliberate backup-file flow compatible with the current reference wallet, not 12 or 24 words. No real secret data.
Panel four: transaction review screen "Review transfer", TESTNET badge and labeled rows "Recipient" "trq1q...7d9p", "Amount" "12.50000000 RQT", "Network fee" "0.00001000 RQT", "Total" "12.50001000 RQT". Final password input label "Wallet password" masked. Orange final action "Confirm and send", secondary "Back". Explain in small English copy "Signed on this device." Recipient is illustrative shortened address, not a real transfer. No password from server/admin used in wallet.
Board caption outside panels "SETUP / BACKUP / REVIEW" and "Design concept · Illustrative data". Clean thin line icons and original Requant visual identity. Do not add 2FA/OTP, biometrics guarantees, recovery words, cloud key escrow, dollar prices, exchange/swap/staking, security-audit claims, iOS, Russian text, geography, MagnetGate branding or real keys.
Input image 2: reference for the matching Requant Wallet desktop component styling and typography. Preserve this wallet identity across all four setup panels.
prompts.desktop-refinement:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Requant Wallet desktop concept refinement.
Input image 1: edit target, the existing desktop wallet design. Keep its layout, orange R identity, ivory colors, navigation, cards, table, typography, action buttons, testnet badges, data, spacing and illustration unchanged.
Primary request: Make this desktop UI platform-neutral and correct the displayed decimal precision. Remove all OS window-control icons: the three colored dots in the top-left and minimize/maximize/close symbols at the top-right. Keep a simple neutral clean title bar instead. Remove the tiny decorative marketing slogan next to the grid in the balance panel; leave the subtle grid motif as-is, without accompanying text. Correct the main balance to EXACTLY "1,248.50000000", the Pending balance to EXACTLY "12.00000000 RQT", and the Maturing balance to EXACTLY "36.00000000 RQT", using exactly eight digits after the decimal point. Ensure these labels remain large and legible and fit naturally in their current slots. Preserve all other text and elements. English only. No new features, values, tokens, slogans or UI elements.
